cards.meaning: on one hand ... on the other hand
cards.example: 一方面，标普和纳斯达克都创下新高；另一方面，德黑兰否认了霍尔木兹海峡的框架协议。
cards.examplePinyin: yì fāngmiàn, biāopǔ hé nàsīdákè dōu chuàngxià xīngāo; lìng yì fāngmiàn, dé hēi lán fǒurèn le huò ěr mù zī hǎixiá de kuàngjià xiéyì.
cards.exampleMeaning: On one hand, the S&P and Nasdaq both hit new highs; on the other hand, Tehran denies the Hormuz framework exists.
cards.note: Neutral-to-formal register, common in financial reporting and news analysis — built to lay out two opposing facts without passing judgment. Near-synonym: 虽然……但是 leans toward concession/turn; 一方面……另一方面 is more balanced, just stating two coexisting realities with neither overriding the other.
cards.tiesTo: market pricing resolution on three fronts while the underlying facts stay unresolved

cards.meaning: to reverse, to turn completely around
cards.example: 帕兰泰尔一份财报就逆转了整整两周的跌势。
cards.examplePinyin: pà lán tài ěr yí fèn cáibào jiù nìzhuǎn le zhěngzhěng liǎng zhōu de diēshì.
cards.exampleMeaning: One earnings report from Palantir completely reversed two weeks of decline.
cards.note: Emphasizes a complete, clean flip of the original direction — used for scores, market trends, things with a clear direction. Near-synonym 扭转 is gentler and more abstract (turning around a situation or an image), not necessarily a full reversal, just an adjustment toward something better.
cards.tiesTo: Palantir's Q2 beat reversing the AI-capex-punishment pullback

cards.meaning: to retreat, to back off, to give back ground
cards.example: Umatras ang piso ngayong araw, mula sa pinakamalakas nitong pagsara sa loob ng mahigit isang buwan noong Lunes.
cards.exampleMeaning: The peso retreated today, from its strongest close in over a month on Monday.
cards.note: Opposite direction from bumawi (already taught) — bumawi is rising back up after a fall; umatras is giving way, pulling back after a rise. From Spanish 'atrás,' carries a tactical, deliberate sense of backing off rather than simply weakening.
cards.tiesTo: the peso giving back Monday's de-escalation-driven rally

cards.meaning: to vanish, to fade away, to dissipate completely
cards.example: Lumaho na ang bagyong Luis ilang oras lamang matapos tumama sa lupa.
cards.exampleMeaning: Storm Luis vanished just hours after making landfall.
cards.note: More literary than plain mawala ('to be gone/lost') — carries a sense of gradualness, like smoke or mist slowly fading until no trace is left, rather than an abrupt disappearance. Doubles as a metaphor for something slowly disappearing, not just weather.
cards.tiesTo: Tropical Depression Luis dissipating hours after landfall, and Ellen Pau's elegy to a vanishing Hong Kong
